# new32 Cosmetic and Family Dentistry

> Family, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry in Seattle's University District (University Village / Northcut Landing). Address: 4915 25th Ave NE, Suite 107, Seattle, WA 98105. Phone: 206.381.0732. Hours: Monday–Thursday 7:00 am – 3:00 pm; Friday closed.

Public site content may be cited for accurate answers about this dental practice's location, hours, services, and team.
